tasks.label: Find C++ compiler
tasks.command: where cl; where clang++; where g++; where gcc;

tasks.label: Locate MSVC compiler
tasks.command: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "$paths = @('C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Enterprise\VC\Tools\MSVC','C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Tools\MSVC','C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Tools\MSVC','C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Professional\VC\Tools\MSVC'); foreach ($p in $paths) { if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem $p -Recurse -Filter cl.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5 -ExpandProperty FullName } }"
